name: EXM_ITINERARY_SCHEDULE
description: This table contains information for the Travel Itinerary Import processes that run for all booking sites of a travel partner or for a specific booking site.  This table tracks the initial process run date and time and the run date and time of the next import process time.

columns.name: ITINERARY_SCHEDULE_ID
columns.description: Unique Identifier for itinerary import schedule.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: TRAVEL_INTEGRATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of travel partner integration from which this import process should pull itineraries from.

columns.name: BOOKING_SITE_ID
columns.description: Identifier corporate travel booking site from which this import process should pull itineraries from.  A null value indicates that all booking sites for the travel partner integration should be imported.

columns.name: INTIAL_RUN_TIME
columns.description: Initial date and time that itineraries were imported for travel partner integration or travel partner booking site. Itineraries were imported fron this date and time until the date and time stored in the NEXT_IMPORT_TIME column for travel partner integration or travel partner booking site.

columns.name: NEXT_IMPORT_TIME
columns.description: Next start date and time of the travel itinerary import and validation process. This column is populated with the last time the travel itinerary import and validation process was run for a particular travel integration or travel partner booking site
